ranks: The Hobbit (HOB)'s last 38 and Marvel Super Heroes Commander (MSC)'s first 22: each set's top 50% by EDHREC rank (the set walk's next 60)

authored.name: Beorn, Reluctant Host // Till and Tend

blocked.name: Bolg of the North
blocked.why: 'amass Goblins X, where X is that excess damage' — no amount for the excess damage dealt by this effect (only excessToController and the excessDamageThisTurn filter exist).

blocked.name: Galactus, Devourer of Worlds
blocked.why: Insatiable Hunger: 'attacks an opponent with the most life among your opponents each combat if able' — must-attack lets the controller pick any defender; no requirement naming which player, and no 'unless you control a creature named X' clause.

blocked.name: Glorious Purpose
blocked.why: No 'whenever a creature you control connives' trigger, and no 'when the sixth plan counter is put on this' trigger.

blocked.name: Azog, Moria's Ruin
blocked.why: 'Its controller amasses Goblins X' — amass always acts for the effect's controller; it has no controller-of-target player (the destroyed creature's last controller, who may be an opponent).

blocked.name: Bilbo, Luckwearer // Burglar's Plot
blocked.why: Burglar's Plot: 'Exchange control of two target nonland permanents that share a card type' — no exchange-of-control effect, nor a 'shares a card type with the other target' target relation.

blocked.name: Inside Information
blocked.why: The opponent's-library impulse is built, but 'if you cast a spell this way, pay life equal to its mana value rather than pay its mana cost' isn't an impulse-exile option (only free or normal cost).

blocked.name: Key to the Side-Door
blocked.why: 'Discard a legendary card with the same name as a legendary permanent you control' — a discard cost's CardFilter has only nameDiffersFromEach/nameUnlike, no 'shares a name with a permanent matching F'.

blocked.name: Supper for Spiders
blocked.why: No filter for creature cards put into a graveyard from the battlefield this turn (only from the library); the returned cards also become Food artifacts losing their other types indefinitely.

blocked.name: Tippy-Toe, Terrific Partner
blocked.why: 'Instead create those tokens plus an additional Food token' — would-create-token replacements only multiply or substitute (Divine Visitation), never add a different token.

blocked.name: Iron Man, Bleeding Edge
blocked.why: 'You may copy it, except the copy isn't legendary' — copy-spell takes no copy exceptions, so a legendary artifact spell's token copy would hit the legend rule.

blocked.name: Dwarven Mauler
blocked.why: "Equip abilities you activate that target this creature cost {2} less": abilityCostModification has no equip-only flag and no clause on the ability's target

blocked.name: Riddles in the Dark
blocked.why: separating four cards into a face-down and a face-up pile, an opponent choosing one, isn't built

blocked.name: Head of the Hunt
blocked.why: the would-be-put-into-graveyard exile replacement (Liesa's) has no "When you do, create a 2/2 Wolf" reflexive trigger per replaced death

blocked.name: Celebrate the Mountain-king
blocked.why: its ruling returns the exiled cards immediately with nothing in between (rule 610.3); the engine's O-Ring return is a leaves-battlefield trigger on the stack (Grasp of Fate stays out on the same). Per-opponent { seat } targets and recruit (draw, discard, this-way discarded nonland) are expressible

blocked.name: Last Light of Durin's Day
blocked.why: "search your hand and/or library for a Dragon card and put it onto the battlefield": search-library's zones are library/graveyard/both, never the hand

blocked.name: Molecule Man
blocked.why: miracle isn't built, nor a static granting it to nonland cards in hand

blocked.name: Ultron, Unlimited
blocked.why: no "whenever a creature you control connives" trigger (connive emits no event); the attack connive itself is expressible

blocked.name: Iron Monger, Sadistic Tycoon
blocked.why: no "whenever a creature you control connives" trigger

blocked.name: Doom's Time Platform
blocked.why: exiling a graveyard card with two time counters and granting it suspend: only suspend's own cast path marks a card suspended
